description: TPO 155 T4 1x Oak to reduce height by up to 5.5m and lateral spread on all sides by up to 4m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The tree is located in the rear garden of 6 Eastbury Avenue. The mature tree appears to be in a good condition and can be viewed from neighbouring properties and from Eastbury Road. Considering the trees condition and visibility, it is considered to have a high amenity value.
This application has been refused as the work to reduce the height by 5.5m and reduce lateral growth by 4m is considered too severe, and will reduce the amenity value of the tree.

The application also states that the reduction is part of a staged dismantlement of the tree. We would not support the removal of the tree unless agreed as part of an insurance claim with supporting evidence such as an Arboricultural Report and Level Monitoring.
This application has been refused as the proposed work is not proportionate at this stage, and is likely to negatively affect the amenity value of the tree.
The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.
